premises.text: Data is the new gold and companies that empower employees to mine data will succeed
premises.evidence_span: Data is the new gold. In the new data-driven economy, every job will require data analysis, and companies that can empower their employees to easily mine the data will be the ones that succeed.

premises.text: There is a data divide inside companies between skilled data miners and others
premises.evidence_span: But today there's a data divide inside companies between people who have the skills to mine data and everybody else who are scared of big data and the deluge of data that's coming their way.

premises.text: Data is fragmented across different services, creating silos
premises.evidence_span: Compounding this problem is the fact that today all our data is fragmented across different services. Analytics data in mixed panel, payments data in Stripe, and so on. Data is in silos, and it's only going to get worse as we embrace more and more services in the near future.

premises.text: Pattern EQ unifies data from different services to extract patterns automatically
premises.evidence_span: Pattern EQ unifies all your data by connecting to all your different services and lets you extract patterns out of it automatically.

premises.text: The software can predict customer behavior and identify at-risk customers
premises.evidence_span: PatternEQ is going to tell me who has the highest likelihood of canceling the service.

premises.text: Analysts can gain deep insights without needing to be data scientists
premises.evidence_span: an analyst coming into the service can get deep insights that typically require you to be a data scientist or depend on a data scientist.

value.text: Data science becomes accessible to everyone through Pattern EQ
value.evidence_span: we make it super simple for you to use predictive insights
